en: A colorized vintage postcard showing a large wooden mountain lodge perched on a steep grassy slope with rocky outcrops. In the background, a prominent conical mountain rises under a partly cloudy sky. The foreground features alpine terrain, and the building appears to be a high-altitude hut. Printed captions in German are visible in the lower margin of the image.
